provenance.git_head_subject: W11: BLAST release contract fixed (eventStats.frameNumber = latched frame; client buffer cache resolved); pool back to 2; 832 frames with 2 gralloc allocations
provenance.memory_types: Pss / Pss_Anon / Pss_File / Pss_Shmem / Private_Dirty / Shared (sum) from smaps_rollup, summed over each session's process tree; cgroup memory.current/memory.peak of the guest's own scope; host used = MemTotal-MemAvailable; host PSS = sum of Pss over every host process. Never summed across types.
